ideas.idea: In a choppy market, a coin whose daily close stands many of its own daily swings (over the last 20 days) below its prior 20-day high falls over the next 5 days, more the more swings below that high it stands.
ideas.consequence: In a choppy market, a coin that has slid far below its recent high is a short, and a reason to refuse longs on it, rather than a rebound buy.
ideas.name: choppy deep-below-high keeps falling

ideas.idea: A coin's move over the next 5 days is larger the nearer its daily close stands to its prior 20-day high, measured in its own daily swings over the last 20 days: higher near or above the high, lower deep below it.
ideas.consequence: A trader leans long on coins closing near their recent high and away from coins far below it, whatever the market's trend.
ideas.name: nearness to high, every market

ideas.idea: In a rising market, a coin's rise over the next 5 days is larger the fewer of its own daily swings over the last 20 days its daily close stands below its prior 20-day high, with the largest rise once the close reaches the high.
ideas.consequence: In a rising market, a trader scales up longs as a coin closes in on its recent high, instead of waiting for it to stand far above.
ideas.name: rising approach to high
